description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the Policy interface for the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines a final class ImmutablePolicy with methods for creating, manipulating, and serializing Policy objects, along with internal data structures such as PolicyEntry, PolicyId, and various metadata fields.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicy
classes.description: An immutable, final implementation of the Policy interface, representing a read-only policy structure with various methods for manipulation and serialization. It encapsulates policy metadata, entries, lifecycle, revision, and timestamps.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Policy instance with specified ID, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and entries. Deprecated version accepts String for policyId, new version accepts PolicyId object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutablePolicy object from a JSON representation, parsing metadata, entries, and other fields.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the PolicyId.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the namespace string.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the PolicyLifecycle.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the PolicyRevision.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the timestamp of last modification.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the timestamp of creation.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional with metadata; currently unimplemented.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns true if the policy lifecycle state indicates deletion.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutablePolicy with the specified PolicyEntry added or replaced.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns the set of labels (as keys) from the entries.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an entry with the given label exists.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional PolicyEntry for a given label.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutablePolicy with the entry for the given label removed.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutablePolicy with the specified subjects set for the entry with given label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Adds a subject to the entry associated with the label, creating or updating the entry.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a subject (by SubjectId) from the entry associated with label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Sets Resources for an entry identified by label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Sets a Resource for an entry, creating or updating the entry.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource identified by ResourceKey from an entry.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Retrieves permissions affected for a specific label, SubjectId, and ResourceKey.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are any entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a set of all PolicyEntries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of PolicyEntries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the PolicyEntries.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy into a JSON object, considering schema version and predicate filtering.
